boundary_status.meaning: Nominal analytic-circle/reference-domain margin supplied by the current layout, not safe stroke.
boundary_status.actual_staircase_xmax_status: Not bound by a scalar metadata field in these descriptor reads; never substitute analytic centre+radius.
boundary_status.source_cell_rule: Native cell centre inside closed analytic circle; boundary is native staircase, not fitted analytic circle.
boundary_status.right_edge_boundary_condition: x=92 is a finite computational extent, not an automatic rigid wall. Known background symmetry fixes uy on y=40 across x0..92; do not infer an x-clamp from extent.
pending_before_nonzero_probe: Bind original selected body staircase xmax from an allowed geometry source with index/coordinate provenance.
Fix right-edge/medium BC and a stated buffer; inspect actual deformed geometry/J in any later solve.
Do not treat a nominal3mm buffer as approved travel or assume it remains3mm after deformation.

control_options.body_unknown: One common q_x for both mirrored halves, with rigid ties; uy=0 and theta_z=0 constrained.
control_options.input: Specified full-assembly external +x generalized load P_full, not the existing actuator R.
control_options.additional_implementation_need: A genuine rigid q unknown and its external-load equilibrium, not simply unfixing original medium nodes or reusing single-actuator mean KKT.
control_options.post_detachment_issue: Ideal detached free x motion under nonzero external load has no static equilibrium; finite-gamma medium may instead provide artificial support. Neither nonconvergence nor background-supported convergence proves release/retention.
control_options.recommendation: Later, after a displacement probe and explicit physical capacity/stability criteria.

control_options.body_kinematics: u_x(i)=q_x for every original workpiece node; u_y(i)=0, theta_z=0; same original node/cell cohort, no re-rasterization.
control_options.input: Prescribe q_x while holding the existing gripper input at d_in=1.06 mm.
control_options.output: Required generalized probe drive reaction Q_drive_half=-F_on_x_half when no independent body force is applied; separately retain material/Hu signed ON-body components.
control_options.advantages: Controls the otherwise free rigid coordinate; a force-versus-prescribed-displacement response stays interpretable without claiming a detached force-controlled equilibrium.
control_options.limitations: It is a guided kinematic probe, not free workpiece bearing, failure-load certification or release.
control_options.recommendation: Nearest minimum implementation/validation target, after this specification is agreed.

candidate_minimum_task.geometry_material_and_gamma: Use existing archived geometry/material as reference, no silent domain/gamma/alpha tuning.
candidate_minimum_task.workpiece_coordinate: prescribed common rigid +x q; y translation and rotation remain constrained
candidate_minimum_task.q_path_status: Illustrative first nonzero probe only, contingent on the unresolved actual staircase/boundary buffer and explicit later approval; not an approved resource/physical task.
candidate_minimum_task.baseline: q=0 must be explicitly revalidated for the new kinematic/control contract. Existing fixed-rigid peak is only a possible initial guess, not an authorized default resume or inherited qualification.
candidate_minimum_task.reporting: Keep absolute signed reaction at q=0 and q>0; do not subtract preload to force an artificial zero. Record actual body pose, actuator R separately, half-model ON-body components and probe drive reaction.
candidate_minimum_task.functional_acceptance_to_specify: Rigid ties/pose and input hold are satisfied, original equilibrium/J/constraint gates hold, generalized reaction/load signs and half/full work convention are consistent. This would validate the probe capability, not effective grip.
not_targets: A bearing capacity or maximum load ranking
Free translation in y or body rotation/tipping
A free-release trajectory or dynamic settling

half_to_full_convention.prescribed_probe_reaction: Q_drive_full=2*Q_drive_half for the same symmetric common q; already-thickness-scaled N.
half_to_full_convention.vertical_resultant: Mirrored Fy cancels in full net; do not interpret this as zero opposed interaction, nor use2absFy as a certified pullout capacity.
half_to_full_convention.qualification: These are symbolic symmetry/work conventions for a proposed task; no new mirrored force values were computed.

medium_and_observer_limits: Because gamma>0 multiplies medium Lamé/shear coefficients, the third medium can transmit residual shear; this is not a new Coulomb friction law and its Lamé mu is not a friction coefficient.
The current workpiece is a fixed kinematic overlay on original medium cells. Unlocking nodes alone creates a soft deformable medium region, not a moving rigid body.
Current saved nodal coordinates equal actual coordinates only under the old zero-lift/fluctuation body contract; a new translated-body observer must use actual pose and state its moment origin.

With an independent applied body load, the old fixed/no-body-load holding=-ONbody identity cannot be copied blindly; the complete force balance includes external load and any remaining constraint reactions.
